mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 2% does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and retail sales (RSAFS) also increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime, a decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals further weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decrease does not correlate with subsequent market downturns during recessions.
